CustomField.description: Annual leave accrued to date at 1 day per month, capped at the year's allocation. Returns 0 when Start_Date__c is blank or still in the future, so the check fails closed rather than blank or negative. Note this evaluates the real TODAY() and so cannot follow a simulated date passed to LeaveManagementController.runDaily().
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), Start_Date__c > TODAY()), 0, MAX(0, MIN( BLANKVALUE(Annual_Leave_Allocated__c, 0), IF( YEAR(Start_Date__c) = YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Start_Date__c) + 1, MONTH(TODAY()) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Accrued Leave Days
